name: corpus-qa
title: Corpus quality check
description: Quality control before analysis: non-text files ingested by mistake, duplicate texts, very short or very long texts, encoding problems, metadata mismatches and tagging, with the most atypical texts listed.

min_words.description: Texts with fewer words are flagged.

outlier_factor.description: Texts longer than this times the median are flagged.

interpretation: Report issues by severity (error first). 'non_text' or very high NON_WORD_RATIO usually means a binary or badly converted file got into the corpus: recreate the corpus without it. Duplicates inflate frequencies and keyness: remove one copy. Very short texts may be empty conversions; very long ones may dominate frequencies (check DP in later analyses). 'encoding' points to texts read with the wrong encoding (convert to UTF-8). Use corpus_read_file to inspect suspicious texts before recommending changes; never delete anything without the user's confirmation.
